spec.situation_desc: has a card payment they don't recognise
spec.vuln_cue: says they don't really understand online banking and their son normally does it

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Hello, Thistle Bank, Hannah speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It’s Kwame Okonkwo. There’s a card payment I don’t recognise, and I’m really unhappy about this.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Before I discuss the account, I need to check your identity. What’s your date of birth and the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It’s the 14th of February 1962, and 27 Ashfield Road, Leeds.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. Which payment is it?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: £86.40 to Northstar Digital on the 22nd of October. I’ve never bought anything from them.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can see it. I’ll record that you don’t recognise the payment.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: This is exactly the sort of thing that makes me lose faith in the bank. I don’t really understand online banking; my son normally does it in passing.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Sorry to hear that. I’ve noted the payment.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: So what are you actually going to do about it?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m logging this as a complaint. I’ll own the follow-up and send it to our card disputes team today.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: And when will I hear back?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’ll receive a full written response within 15 business days. I’ll check that the referral has been sent and contact you by phone by 5pm tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right. I’ll wait for that, then.
